title: An investigation of structures responsible for gender bias in BERT and DistilBERT

bias_targets.methodology: Fine-tuning models on gender-balanced versus gender-imbalanced subsets of the Bias in Bios dataset for an occupation classification task, evaluating fairness using Equalized Odds (EO), and identifying structural causes of bias via attention head ablation, Jensen-Shannon divergence of attention weights, and SVCCA distance of hidden states.
